title: Former pro baseball player Yutaka Enatsu dies; recorded 206 career wins and 401 strikeouts in a season
summary: The famed pitcher, known as a 'championship closer' for teams such as Hanshin and Hiroshima, has passed away at age 78.

title: Niigata home center warned by Fair Trade Commission for forcing suppliers to dispatch workers without pay
summary: The FTC demanded measures to prevent recurrence after over 1,000 supplier employees were made to work for free for store opening preparations and other tasks.

title: Unauthorized access to RIKEN supercomputer 'Fugaku', risk of personal data leak
summary: Traces of attempts to connect to other systems using the obtained information have also been confirmed, and an investigation is underway.

title: Issues found in child guidance center's response to 3-year-old abuse death in Hirakata, Osaka; Governor Yoshimura orders review
summary: The governor called for a detailed investigation into the issue where related agencies were aware of the abuse before receiving formal notification from the city.

title: Following Docomo's communication outage, Internal Affairs Minister calls 'three times in a short period regrettable', demands cause investigation and recurrence prevention
summary: Taking the series of troubles seriously, the Minister of Internal Affairs and Communications demanded strict measures from the company.

title: Princess Aiko departs Haneda Airport for Singapore upon invitation for 60th anniversary of diplomatic relations
summary: She will visit the country on an official visit to deepen goodwill, including having a new species of flower named after an imperial family member. There are also reports of Iran plotting an attack in Washington.

title: US federal district court orders cancellation of rule shortening visa periods for students and media, calling it 'arbitrary'
summary: The judiciary ordered an injunction against the rule introduced by the US government, stating it lacked rationality.

title: French Football Federation president to run in FIFA presidential election; UEFA seeking to back him
summary: To counter incumbent President Infantino, UEFA has moved to back the head of the French federation. There is also intelligence of an Iranian 'dirty bomb' plot in Washington.

title: Ai Iinuma cast as heroine in NHK's autumn 2027 morning drama 'Nagisa no Shinkaron'
summary: The cast for the protagonist, who will play a veterinarian, has been announced for the morning drama scheduled to air next autumn.
